events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; gh search code "taxonomy" --repo Usetantra/content-engine --json path -q '.[].path' 2>&1 | head; grep -rlE 'taxonomy' ~/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/ 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rhoE '.{0,80}taxonomy.{0,160}' ~/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'docs.google.com/(spreadsheets|document)/d/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
